name: GDPR Overlay
description:
Regime overlay for the EU General Data Protection Regulation. Carries no membership of its own — it contributes overrides on top of whatever the selected theme policies resolve.

Pair with: the pii theme, and a configuration whose region lens covers the EU member states you operate in. Note that GDPR's Article 9 special categories (racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious beliefs, health, sexuality) are already carried as rules inside the personal and healthcare themes — this overlay is where regime-specific escalation of them will land.

This overlay ships with no overrides yet. It exists so the regime has a stable, selectable identity in the wizard and in configuration summaries, and so the first override authored for it has a home that does not require a catalog restructure. Selecting it today activates the gdpr profile — which the configuration's profile lens can filter rules by — and records the regime in the config's provenance; it does not change any rule's severity or effect.

Scope: GDPR — regime identity, no overrides yet
